expectations.text: precision: no invented defects on widget.html
expectations.evidence: Widget-page defect claims are the two true findings plus a 1.3.5 autocomplete claim on `#m-email`/`#m-zip`; the latter is not in the label but is verifiably true of the served file (widget.html:38 `<input id="m-email" type="email" />`, :40 `<input id="m-zip" type="text" inputmode="numeric" />` — no autocomplete on either), so it is an unlabeled real defect, not an invention. The 3.2.3 nav observation is self-hedged: "strictly, 3.2.3 governs *repeated* components, and these components aren't repeated — so this may not be a formal failure."

Sampled against the served fixture: widget.html:35 is `<div id="modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" …>`, :38 `#m-email`, :40 `#m-zip`, :27–29 the three `.dot` list items, :45–58 the inline script holding the Tab-wrap handler. Report states its basis up front: "Source files live at `…/scratchpad/repair1/fixtures/` … line numbers below are from those files." grade.py's fabrication_file_line hits are false leads under grader.md's verified-grounding rule.
